item.title: MdView 0.4.5
item.description: • Make MdView your default Markdown app from Settings, with current status and Finder instructions if the change fails.

item.title: MdView 0.4.4
item.description:
• Click diagrams and images to zoom and pan, with Fit and 100% controls.
  • Choose wider inline diagrams and images independently in Reading settings.
  • Improved diagram label rendering and theme-aware styling with solid borders, subtle fills, and softly rounded corners.

item.title: MdView 0.4.3
item.description: • Fixed the blank Dock icon by loading the bundled app artwork explicitly at launch.

item.title: MdView 0.4.2
item.description:
• Fixed the welcome window showing a generic placeholder instead of the MdView icon.
  • New warm-paper installer layout with a clear drag-to-Applications guide.

item.title: MdView 0.4.1
item.description: • Refreshed app icon: a cleaner Md monogram on lined paper, with improved clarity at small sizes.

item.title: MdView 0.4.0
item.description:
• Agent panel (✨ in a notebook window): run Claude Code, Codex or a custom command on a notebook, folder or page, with streaming output and follow-ups (Settings → Agents)
  • Checkpoints and a Changes view: see what an agent added, modified, deleted or renamed, with line diffs, and revert or accept
  • mdview command line tool (MdView → Install Command Line Tool…): open files and folders, query pages, links, backlinks, tags and search, check links, and create or move pages while updating links
  • File → Set Up Notebook for Agents… writes an AGENTS.md describing the notebook

item.title: MdView 0.3.0
item.description:
• In-app Help (Help → MdView Help, ⌘?) with a Markdown cheat sheet, wiki link and tag guide, and keyboard shortcuts
  • Front matter tags with a sidebar Tags list and #tag search
  • Notebook Edit mode (⇧⌘E) and optional autosave
  • Missing Pages sidebar section; create pages from Go to Page

item.title: MdView 0.2.0
item.description:
• Welcome window with pinned and recent files, folders and notebooks; also in File → Open Recent and the Dock menu
  • Notebooks: create, rename and delete pages and folders in a personal wiki folder
  • [[Wiki links]] between pages; clicking a link to a missing page offers to create it
  • Search every page of a folder (⇧⌘F) and Go to Page (⌘K)
  • “Linked From” lists the pages that link to the current one
  • Renaming updates links that point to the page or folder
  • Folders refresh automatically when files change in other apps
  • Links open as in Safari: ⌘-click for a background tab, ⇧⌘-click for a new tab, ⌥⌘-click for a new window

item.title: MdView 0.1.1
item.description:
• Links to web pages and other files now ask before opening and show where they lead.
  • Apps, scripts and installers are never launched from a document; MdView offers to show them in Finder instead.
  • Remote images are blocked until you click Load Remote Images. To always load them, turn on Settings → Privacy → Load remote images automatically.
  • Documents can only load local images, audio and video.
